taxpayer_name.rationale: No canonical element exists for taxpayer name on Form 4562; it is a header field not represented as a discrete XML element in the MeF schema.

taxpayer_identifying_number.rationale: No canonical element exists for the identifying number (SSN/EIN) header field in the IRS4562 schema candidate list.

business_activity.rationale: BusinessOrActivityTxt row label explicitly matches 'Business or activity to which this form relates' header line.

line_14_special_depreciation_allowance.rationale: SpecialAllowanceAmt corresponds to Form 4562 Part II Line 14 special depreciation allowance for qualified property other than listed property.

line_15_property_section_168f1_election.rationale: Section168f1ElectedPropertyAmt directly maps to Part II Line 15 property subject to Section 168(f)(1) election.

line_16_other_depreciation.rationale: OtherDepreciationAmt corresponds to Part II Line 16 other depreciation including ACRS and pre-MACRS methods.
